units.title: P-N Junction Diode, Applications and Special Purpose Diodes.
topics: 1.1. Semiconductor Material: Germanium, silicon, atomic structure and characteristics of semiconductor material.
1.2. P-N junction Diode: Symbol, Forward and Reverse biased characteristics.
1.3. Rectifiers: half wave and full wave – centre tapped and bridge rectifier for R load.
1.4. Troubleshooting: Troubleshooting of P-N junction diode using ohm meter and multimeter.
1.5. Reading a Data Sheet: Reverse Breakdown Voltage, Maximum Forward Current, Forward Voltage Drop, Maximum Reverse Current.
1.6. Diode clipper: positive negative clipper
1.7. Diode clamper: positive and negative clamper.
1.10. LED: voltage and current through LED, Applications.
1.11. Photo diode: symbol, working principle
1.12. Opto-coupler: working principle, Applications.
1.13. Schottky diode: working principle, applications.

1.g. Explain working of Light Emitting diode.
1.h. Explain working of Photo diode and Opto-coupler (Opto- isolator)
1.i. Explain working of Schottky diode.
